title: VictoriaMetrics TSDB
descript: VictoriaMetrics is a fast, low-memory time-series database and monitoring solution. It accepts metrics over Prometheus remote-write and the HTTP ingestion endpoints for InfluxDB line protocol, OpenTelemetry and DataDog, stores them locally, and lets you query with PromQL/MetricsQL and explore them in the built-in vmui web UI. One container, one port, data in the application data folder.
release_note: 1.157.0-1 - Rectified per review comments. C3/C4: added PRIVACY.md covering retention, user rights, security measures, third-party sharing and the deletion channel, and pointed the Help link at it. C8: documented that VictoriaMetrics has no telemetry, analytics or version check, and listed the only endpoints the package may contact. C9: corrected the description - the root page links to vmui instead of redirecting, and only the protocols this package actually accepts are listed. C10: completed README with repository layout, privacy, notices, build and data/uninstall sections, added NOTICE.md, and kept the repository public. L01/L03: all 23 language sections define name/auth/descript/release_note/important, use LF endings and contain no ASCII semicolons. P3: display name is now VictoriaMetrics TSDB, so the duplicate-name limit is respected. T1: upstream upgraded from 1.149.0 to 1.157.0 (released 20 Nov 2026) with multi-architecture images. F2: launch flags are passed under command, with the official binary pinned as the entrypoint, so PID 1 is never a flag.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). The web UI is at /vmui (the root page links to it). Point exporters or agents at the same port (remote-write path /api/v1/write). Retention is 12 months, configured in the package. Data lives in DockerAppData/victoriametricsdocker/data. No telemetry or version checks are sent. Plain HTTP without authentication, so use a TLS reverse proxy before exposing it to the internet.

data_notes: `/victoria-metrics-data` (mounted from `DockerAppData/victoriametricsdocker/data`) holds the storage parts, index and metadata.
design_notes: **Startup flags are arguments, never an entrypoint.** The image ENTRYPOINT is pinned to `/victoria-metrics-prod` and the flags live under `command:` as a YAML list, so Docker can never try to exec a flag such as `-storageDataPath=...` as PID 1.

**Health check without HTTP tools.** The image ships `sh` and `grep`, so the check greps the listening port (8428 = 0x20EC) in `/proc/net/`; unlike curl/wget this works on every published architecture.
**One port for API and UI.** Prometheus remote-write, the HTTP ingestion endpoints, the PromQL API and vmui share port 8428.

**No telemetry, no version check.** The binary has no analytics, crash-reporting or update endpoint. `-selfScrapeInterval` and `-pushmetrics.url` are deliberately left unset, so the container makes no outbound connection unless the administrator configures scrape targets.
limitations: - It stores metrics; exporters or agents must send data to it.
- The UI is plain HTTP and has no built-in authentication; use a TLS reverse proxy and network restrictions before exposing it.
- Retention and disk usage are your responsibility; watch free space on the NAS.
- Metrics are stored as received; deleting individual series requires the admin API.
